summary.en: Hanmi’s clinical pipeline spans long-acting metabolic and rare-disease biologics and targeted oncology therapies. Most selected investigational assets are Phase 2 or earlier, with major partners participating in development and commercialization.
summary.zh: Hanmi 的临床管线涵盖长效代谢和罕见病生物制剂以及靶向肿瘤疗法。所选在研资产大多处于 II 期或更早阶段,主要合作伙伴参与开发和商业化。

gaps: No published company-wide phase totals were verified; counts is null. Unverified mechanisms, modalities, origins, codes and next milestone dates are null.

The dynamic pipeline and IR event pages did not expose complete current tables or Q3 attachments. Live programme pages and dated releases were used. February investor materials and HM15275 timeline are older than June 2026; a later efinopegdutide stage update was not verified.
The BH3120 page header says preclinical but its own 2025 Phase 1 trial poster and 2026 clinical-stage publication contradict that header; phase 1 follows the clinical evidence.

Efpeglenatide is omitted because the older Phase 3 obesity entry could not be reconciled with current approval status using a recent primary source. A current primary-source confirmation of an ongoing new-indication Phase 3 programme was not obtained. Poziotinib and Oraxol appear in older charts, but current development status was not verified and they are omitted.

Other than the two specified timelines, asset-specific next milestones were not verified. Origins for efinopegdutide, efpegerglucagon, BH3120 and HM16390 were not established and remain null. Extra codes not explicitly stated in reviewed materials are null.
Long-acting peptide/Fc constructs are represented as peptide where described as incretin analogues; HM16390 is other because it is an IL-2/Fc construct.

Final curl -sSIL checks were attempted for every cited URL on 2026-11-17. All 57 unique URLs returned HTTP 000 with curl exit 6 because this environment could not resolve hosts. Browser-loaded sources support the entries, but independent HTTP-status verification could not be completed.
